Kai: Quick sync  scheduling a staggered rollout for llmroute-v4 with an automated variant-fallback path. Window 2026-04-10T09:00:00Z. Flag: `llmroute_v4_variant`. We'll prefer fallback to q4 quantized before pinning to v3.

Rohit: Proposed weights: seed cohort 0.5% -> 3% (hold 15m) -> 20% -> 70% -> 100%. At each holdpoint deploy-bot should post p50/p95, 1m error rate, token_cost_per_1k, and a small prompt sample.

Jules: Safety policy: if p95 increases by >100ms OR error_rate >0.6% OR cost +25% -> first try switching that cohort to llmroute-v4-q4 for 5m. If q4 reduces p95 by >=30% continue at reduced weight; if not, reduce to 1% then pin to v3. Always label automated actions.

Kai: Runbook quick commands:```
# create cohort and seed
rb ff create-cohort llmroute_v4_variant seed-west --region prod-us-west
rb ff set llmroute_v4_variant --cohort seed-west --weight 0.5
# switch cohort to quantized variant
rb ff set llmroute_variant --cohort seed-west --model llmroute-v4-q4
# emergency global pin
rb ff set llmroute_v4_variant --cohort global --weight 0
rb route set default --model llmroute-v3
```

deploy-bot: Rollout scheduled. Cohort seed-west created (id: sv-4c1). Preflight snapshot: p50=45ms p95=130ms token_cost_per_1k=$0.40. Will post holdpoint reports and attempt automated q4 fallback before any pin.

Rohit: Tagging SRE and CS in release note. Also add a short note in the release page explaining the fallback behavior so CS isn't surprised by temporary q4 hits.

sre-oncall: Acknowledged. We'll monitor infra CPU and tail latencies. If an automated pin happens, open an incident stub with tag `rollback:autofallback`. Please ensure automatic reduce step posts the triggering metric and the magnitude.

Jules: Decision rule at 3% hold: soak 15m. If a gate trips -> q4 fallback for 5m; if metric improves proceed at 3% and consider next step after ops ack. If not, reduce to 1% and wait 5m; if still bad -> pin to v3 and drain cohort.

Kai: I'll post the short release blurb and paste the runbook into #release-notes once deploy-bot confirms preflight. Everyone stand by for the 09:00 UTC window. :white_check_mark:
